title: theme.json
description: Jisuno theme. Every key is optional: a missing key uses its default. Hot-reloaded; on error the file is rejected and the last good config stays live.

$schema.description: Path of this schema as written under ~/.config/jisuno/schemas/.

name.description: Palette (inkuno Quiet). Used when appearance is fixed.

appearance.description: system follows macOS light and dark; fixed always uses name.

accent_dictate.description: Dictate accent fill, as #rrggbb (lowercase). Text variants are derived from it for legibility.

accent_command.description: Command accent fill, as #rrggbb (lowercase). Text variants are derived from it for legibility.

hud.description: HUD look. Its position is set in settings.json (hud).

style.description: HUD style. island is the only value in v1.

show_latency.description: Show the time in ms after the Inserted line.
